column3: It repeats the same defense: the worshippers found their forefathers devoted to these objects.

It condemns worship of what neither benefits nor harms, restating the criterion behind the focus.

Ibrahim again asks his father and people what they worship, closely paralleling the interrogation in the focus passage.
Ibrahim declares to his father and people that he is free of what they worship, the decisive answer to inherited devotion.
